An '''anti-concussion field generator''' was a type of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] utilized a [[Nordoxicon/Legends|Nordoxicon]] [[38 anticoncussion field generator|unit]].
